更改只影响应用界面，讲稿内容不会被翻译。: This changes the interface language. Your script content is not translated.
两种透明度独立调整。背景越透明，越需要根据底下的窗口检查文字对比度。: Adjust each opacity independently. Check text contrast against the windows behind a transparent background.
Teams 与录屏测试方法: Test with Teams and recording tools
在测试会议中共享整个屏幕，把 Still 放在 PowerPoint 或浏览器上: In a test meeting, share your entire screen with Still above PowerPoint or your browser.
请另一台设备或另一位参会者检查共享画面，并回看会议录制。: Check the shared screen from another device or participant, and review the meeting recording.
分别测试深色、浅色、半透明预设，移动和缩放窗口，再打开编辑与设置。: Test dark, light and transparent presets. Move and resize the window, then open the editor and settings.
关闭捕获排除，确认稿件可见；重新开启后再次检查。: Disable capture exclusion to confirm the script is visible, then enable it and check again.
再用实际使用的录屏工具测试显示器捕获与窗口捕获。: Also test display and window capture in the recording tools you plan to use.
API 成功不代表所有捕获软件都会隐藏窗口。仅在确认实际结果后用于正式演讲。: API success does not guarantee every capture tool will hide the window. Verify the actual result before presenting.
阅读模式下，点击和滚动不会主动切走 Teams 的焦点。编辑、导航、设置会获取焦: Reading mode avoids taking focus from Teams when you click or scroll. Editing, navigation and settings take focus for input. The window stays on top and can be moved, resized or minimized.
全局快捷键可以在其他应用中使用。只触发手动动作，不自动跟随语音。在编辑和设置中暂: Global shortcuts work while other apps are active. They trigger manual actions, without speech following. Reading actions pause in the editor and settings.
浏览器预览无法注册全局快捷键。: Global shortcuts are unavailable in the browser preview.
每个快捷键至少包含 Ctrl、Alt 或 Win；Shift 单独使用不够。: Each shortcut must include Ctrl, Alt or Win. Shift alone is not sufficient.
快捷键组合重复，请为每个动作选择不同组合。: Duplicate shortcuts. Choose a different combination for each action.
稿件、书签、阅读位置和偏好保存在本机，不改动导入的源文件。可导出完整备份，并在编: Scripts, bookmarks, reading positions and preferences are stored on this device. Imported originals are not modified. Export a full backup and import it again in the editor.
立即将稿件和设置保存到本机: Save scripts and settings to this device now
修改会自动保存在本机，下次打开直接恢复。在「导航 → 当前稿件」中可切换已保存的: Changes are saved automatically and restored next time. Switch saved scripts in Navigation → Current script. Exporting is optional.
# 开场\n\n在这里粘贴演讲稿…\n\n[cue] 停顿，看向镜头:
# Opening

Paste your script here…

[cue] Pause and look at the camera
# 标记章节；[cue] 或 ::cue 标记演讲提示。不会自动分类内容。: Use # for sections and [cue] or ::cue for presenter cues. Content is not classified automatically.
稿件还是空的。粘贴内容、导入文件，或添加一个段落。: Your script is empty. Paste text, import a file or add a block.
TXT 导出保留章节和提示标记。要保留字体、书签和阅读位置，请在设置中导出完整备: TXT exports keep section and cue markers. To preserve appearance, bookmarks and reading positions, export a full backup in settings.
删除整份稿件和书签？: Delete this script and its bookmarks?
没有匹配的段落。试试更短的关键词。: No matching blocks. Try a shorter search term.
尚未添加书签。在阅读时点击书签按钮，保存当前位置。: No bookmarks yet. Use the bookmark button while reading to save your position.
还没有章节。在编辑中将段落类型改为「章节」。: No sections yet. Change a block type to Sections in the editor.

粘贴文本，或导入 DOCX、TXT、Markdown 文件。: Paste text or import a DOCX, TXT or Markdown file.

演讲提示已隐藏，已定位到附近正文。: Presenter cues are hidden. Moved to nearby spoken text.

文件中没有可读取的段落。: The file contains no readable blocks.
已导入 {count} 段，源文件未改动。: Imported {count} blocks. The original file was not modified.

本地数据未加载成功。为保护原始文件，保存已暂停。请先导出当前内容或恢复备份。: Local data could not be loaded. Saving is paused to protect the original file. Export your current content or restore a backup.
保存失败：{error}。可在设置中导出备份后重试。: Save failed: {error}. Export a backup in settings, then retry.
读取本地数据失败：{error}。原始文件未覆盖，自动保存已暂停。: Could not load local data: {error}. The original file was not overwritten. Automatic saving is paused.
窗口焦点模式切换失败：{error}: Could not change window focus mode: {error}
本地稿件格式或版本不受支持。原始数据未被覆盖。: Unsupported local script format or version. The original data was not overwritten.
稿件数据不完整。请保留数据文件并从备份恢复。: Script data is incomplete. Keep the data file and restore from a backup.
阅读位置或书签数据无效。: Invalid reading position or bookmark data.
未找到当前稿件。: The current script could not be found.
稿件超过 200 万字符，请拆分成较小文件。: The script exceeds 2 million characters. Split it into smaller files.

文件超过 10 MB，请精简或拆分稿件。: The file exceeds 10 MB. Reduce its size or split the script.

文本编码无法识别，请先另存为 UTF-8 或带 BOM 的 UTF-16 文件。: Unrecognized text encoding. Save the file as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a BOM.
浏览器预览没有 Windows 捕获排除功能。请运行桌面版。: Windows capture exclusion is unavailable in the browser preview. Run the desktop app.
全局快捷键需要桌面版。: Global shortcuts require the desktop app.
至少包含 Ctrl、Alt 或 Win 修饰键，避免拦截普通输入。: Include Ctrl, Alt or Win to avoid intercepting ordinary typing.
最多支持五个全局快捷键。: A maximum of five global shortcuts is supported.
快捷键重复，请选择不同组合。: Duplicate shortcut. Choose a different combination.
注册失败，可能已被其他应用占用：{error}: Registration failed; another app may be using this shortcut: {error}
不支持的数据版本，未覆盖本地文件。: Unsupported data version. The local file was not overwritten.
稿件库超过 40 MB，请先导出并精简内容。: The script library exceeds 40 MB. Export a backup and reduce its size.
无法读取 Windows 版本，未确认捕获排除支持。: Could not read the Windows version. Capture exclusion support could not be confirmed.
捕获排除需要 Windows 10 2004（19041）或更新版本。: Capture exclusion requires Windows 10 2004 (19041) or later.
Windows 已接受并确认捕获排除。请在 Teams 和录屏软件中独立测试。: Windows accepted and confirmed capture exclusion. Test independently in Teams and your recording software.
捕获排除已关闭，稿件可能出现在屏幕共享或录制中。: Capture exclusion is disabled. The script may appear in screen sharing or recordings.
捕获排除只支持 Windows 桌面应用。: Capture exclusion is only supported in the Windows desktop app.
稿件已读完。请向上定位到要继续的正文，再点击开始滚动。: The script has ended. Navigate up to the passage you want to read, then click Start.
定时语速：{rate} 字/分钟。不使用麦克风，手动操作后需继续滚动。: Timed pace: {rate} characters/min. No microphone. Resume after manual navigation.
默认 240 字/分钟。按正文中的文字和数字计数，不计空白、标点、章节标题和演讲: Default: 240 characters/min. Count letters and numbers in spoken text, excluding spaces, punctuation, headings and cues. Each English letter counts as one character.
选择定时模式后点击开始滚动。速度按实际字号、换行和段落间距换算。手动操作会暂停，: Select Timed and click Start. Speed adapts to the font, wrapping and paragraph spacing. Manual navigation pauses scrolling. Resume from the current position; scrolling stops at the end.
定时模式不使用麦克风。切换模式或重启应用后，需要再次点击开始。: Timed mode does not use the microphone. Start explicitly after changing modes or relaunching the app.
请输入 60–1200 之间的整数语速。: Enter a whole-number pace between 60 and 1200.
暂停 / 恢复快捷键也适用于已开始的定时滚动。在编辑和设置中暂不执行阅读动作。: The pause / resume shortcut also controls started timed scrolling. Reading actions are suspended in editing and settings.
已暂停滚动，麦克风仍在监听。点击停止可关闭麦克风。: Follow is paused; the microphone is still listening. Stop releases the microphone.
已暂停滚动；模型加载后将继续监听。点击停止可关闭麦克风。: Follow is paused; listening will continue when the model loads. Stop releases the microphone.
暂停只停止自动滚动，麦克风仍在监听；停止跟读或切回手动才会关闭麦克风。: Pause stops automatic scrolling while the microphone keeps listening. Stop follow or switch to Manual to release the microphone.
显示诊断指标（不包含识别文字或音频）: Show diagnostic metrics (no recognized text or audio)
仅使用本地麦克风；手动滚动后请点击恢复跟读。: Local microphone only. Resume follow after manual scrolling.
SenseVoice 在本机识别中文、英文和混合语音。只有点击开始跟读后才会启用: SenseVoice recognizes Mandarin, English and mixed speech locally. The microphone starts only after you click Start. Audio is never saved or uploaded.
自动跟读需要 Windows 桌面版，本地语音引擎不在浏览器预览中运行。: Auto follow requires the Windows desktop app. Local recognition does not run in the browser preview.
手动滚动、搜索或章节跳转会暂停跟读。回到阅读页，点击恢复跟读，从当前位置重新匹配: Manual scrolling, search and section navigation pause follow. Return to reading and click Resume to match from the current position. Stop follow before changing devices or recognition settings.
全局快捷键可以在其他应用中使用。暂停 / 恢复跟读仅在自动模式已开始后生效。在编: Global shortcuts work while using other apps. Pause / resume applies only after Auto has started. Reading actions are suspended in panels.
缺少本地语音资源：{path}。请在自动跟读设置中指定运行库和模型目录。: Local speech resource missing: {path}. Specify runtime and model directories in Auto follow settings.
本地语音引擎启动失败：{error}: Local speech engine could not start: {error}
语音模型加载超时或引擎退出。请检查本地资源。: Speech model loading timed out or the engine exited. Check local resources.
未找到选定麦克风。请重新连接设备，在设置中刷新并选择麦克风。: Selected microphone not found. Reconnect it, then refresh and select it in settings.
麦克风采样格式不受支持。请选择其他输入设备。: Unsupported microphone sample format. Select another input device.
麦克风无法打开：{error}。请检查 Windows 麦克风权限、设备连接及独: Could not open microphone: {error}. Check Windows microphone permissions, the device connection and exclusive mode.
麦克风已断开或不可用：{error}。请检查设备后重新开始。: Microphone disconnected or unavailable: {error}. Check the device and start again.
麦克风停止传输。请重新连接或选择其他输入设备。: Microphone stopped sending audio. Reconnect it or select another input.
语音识别超时或引擎退出。请重新开始。: Recognition timed out or the engine exited. Start again.
本地语音引擎不可用。请检查设置后重新开始。: Local speech engine unavailable. Check settings and start again.
稿件对齐引擎不可用。请停止跟读后重新开始。: Script alignment engine unavailable. Stop follow and start again.
自动跟读已停止。请重新开始。: Auto follow has stopped. Start again.
最多支持六个全局快捷键。: Up to six global shortcuts are supported.
